featureCronSetup.description: Controls gateway_start provisioning for exactly seven owner-gated jobs: persona-evolve: personaVoice.enabled && skillMiner.enabled; afterthought: afterthought.enabled && (skillMiner.enabled || merging.enabled); consolidate-daily: dailyConsolidation.enabled; classify-recent: criticalPush.enabled; rem-dream: merging.enabled; skill-miner: skillMiner.enabled; discover-semantic-links: obsidianBridge.enabled && obsidianBridge.graphLinks.semanticDiscovery.enabled. Raw sourceConfig owns gates/schedules; effective runtimeConfig owns bindings/accounts/delivery. Outbound delivery uses concrete peer.id/defaultTo, never allowFrom, and fails closed without model or credential overrides.

auto.description: Set false to disable the deferred gateway_start feature-cron bootstrap. Manual `/plur1bus setup crons` and npm postinstall are unaffected.

allowModelDestructiveMemoryOps.description: Allow model-facing memory_forget and knowledge_update tool calls unless explicitly disabled.

allowedUserIds.description: List of allowed Telegram/Discord user IDs. Destructive commands require user-bound auth.

allowedChatIds.description: List of allowed chat/channel IDs. Non-destructive commands may use chat-only auth when allowedUserIds is empty.
